stem: In the figure, line \(PQ\) and line \(RS\) intersect at point \(O\). What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Angles \(QOR\) and \(POS\) are vertical angles, so they are equal.

explanation.A: Correct. Vertical angles are equal: \(4x = 72\), so \(x = 18\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the measure of the angle, \(4x\), not the value of \(x\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the result of treating the angles as supplementary: \(4x = 108\). Vertical angles are equal.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the result of multiplying 72 by 4 instead of dividing.

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'A': 'A', 'C': 'B', 'B': 'C', 'D': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'A', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'D'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(ang('Q','O','R')-72)<0.1 and abs(ang('P','O','S')-72)<0.1
x=symbols('x')
ans=solve(Eq(4*x,72),x)[0]
assert value(choices[answer])==ans==18
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
